questions.learningObjective: Classify a discontinuity from factor multiplicities
questions.stem: Explain why (x-2)^2/(x-2) has a hole, not an asymptote, at x=2.

answer.exemplar: The (x-2) factor cancels completely, leaving (x-2), so x=2 is a hole rather than a vertical asymptote.

questions.explanation: Full cancellation removes the denominator factor, leaving a polynomial. The point x=2 is missing, a hole.
